briefings.tldr: SEC Chairman Paul Atkins and Division of Trading and Markets Director Jamie Selway outline the Commission's push to modernize U.S. market infrastructure through a five-year "Innovation Exemption" sandbox for tokenized securities, an inevitable transition to 24/7 trading, and major cost-cutting reforms to the Consolidated Audit Trail (CAT).
